parts.title: Money, family in the UK and accommodation

groups.tbc: Fields of the other-names group are to confirm (spec 2.3a, 2.3b).

Spec 4.8 does not say whether a Yes/No question opens this group or how many parents are required. Default: no Yes/No question, the group is always shown and needs at least 1 entry (up to the group limit). To confirm.
Spec 6.7d proposes that the next stay starts when this one ends. Default: stays may not overlap, but a gap between two stays, or two stays that meet on the same day, is accepted. To confirm.
